info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v4-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a list of pets that have been adopted through the pet adoption service. It allows users to retrieve detailed information about each adopted pet, including their breed, age, and adoption details. Ideal for animal shelters, rescue organizations, and pet adoption platforms, this endpoint enables seamless integration for tracking adopted pets. Consumers can utilize this data for reporting, analytics, and enhancing their outreach efforts in promoting responsible pet ownership.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all pets that have been adopted. This is particularly useful for tracking the adoption status of pets and managing records in the pet adoption system.
